description: Three evenly spaced circles on a non-square canvas. Repetition plus a canvas that is not 200x200.
prompt: On a 240x120 pixel canvas filled with white (#ffffff), draw three filled circles of radius 30, all centred on the horizontal line y = 60: a red (#ff0000) one centred at (40, 60), a green (#00ff00) one centred at (120, 60), and a blue (#0000ff) one centred at (200, 60). Coordinates are in pixels measured from the top-left corner of the canvas, with x increasing to the right and y increasing downwards.
